title: Page 8
content_zh:
“仗着皇商的身分，就可以为所欲为吗？”寒招财虽然不能确定在船上下毒是不是是娄梓纲指使的，似十分有可能就是他，不然哪来那么多恨娄竹心的人，娄梓纲如此心狠手辣，一再买凶杀害自己的妹妹，居然还能全身而退，逍遥法外，何其不公。

路挽风向她承诺，“你放心，我不会让他逃过该有的惩罚。”她想为娄竹心讨回公道，他答应过会帮她，就绝不会食言。

寒招财不平的心绪瞬间被他的允诺给抚平，“你这么做是为了我，还是为了还我的救命之恩？”

“我曾说过今后你的事就是我的事。”他牵握住她的手，冷峻的面容异常认真，“你先前不是对我表露心迹，说在天愿做比翼鸟，大难来时一起飞。你都愿意在大难时陪着我一起飞，我更不会在你有事时弃你于不顾，往后无论什么事，我们都一起承担。”

“我哪里有对你表露什么心迹，那是我随口说的。”她娇嗔的横他一眼，接着又笑开了，问他，“你当时听了是不是很感动，所以回去后，就恨不得迎娶我为妻？”

“你说的都对。”路挽风不想与她做无谓的争辩，索性由着她，他总算体会到父亲的心情。母亲生前与父亲说话时，有些事分明是她无理，但在外头说话向来一言九鼎的父亲，却总是一脸无奈的安抚她道：“娘子说的都对，全是为夫的错。”

那样的退让，是对母亲的一种宠爱，男子汉大丈夫，让着妻子是天经地义的事。

路挽风看着寒招财，忽然有些骄傲的暗自这么想着。

“哪里对了？”寒招财不太满意他的敷衍，“你知不知道女人的耳朵，需要定期的喂养一些甜分。”

路挽风顿时为自己的无知惊到，“什么，竟有这种事？可我怎么没瞧过我娘和我祖母这么做过？”

见他竟没有会意过来，寒招财又好气又好笑，“这种事不好常当着外人的面前做。”

“是吗？”他面露狐疑。

“倘若没有定期的喂养甜分，你知道会发生什么后果吗？”

他摇头，第一次听闻这种事，哪里知道会有什么后果。瞅着她脸上的表情，他隐隐觉得有哪里不对动，该不会是她在骗他吧？

她告诉他答案，“女人的耳朵没了甜分的喂养，会逐渐变得面目可憎。”她盯着他的双眼，一字一字慢慢说，“你不想我以后变成那样吧？”

“当然不想，我该怎么做？”他总算省悟自己方才似乎说错什么话，惹到她了，虚心向她求教。

见他这般孺子可教，她笑盈盈指教，“以后不要随便敷衍我，说甜言蜜语时要认真一点，这样我的耳甜了，才能维持住如花的美貌。”

他能不能先到旁边去吐一吐，再回来和她说话？他是看她现在这张脸无比顺眼，但她离如花的美貌还有一段不小的距离，以前那张娄竹心的脸，倒是当之无愧。

他思忖着该不该告诉她实话，下一瞬觉得还是算了，让她高兴点也好。

“在我心里，不论怎么样的你都是最美的。”他将她搂进怀里，吻住她那张伶牙利的嘴。

他不会太多甜言蜜语，但他可以用实际的行动来让她甜到心坎里。

寒招财被他给吻得神魂颠倒，约莫是最近两人常“练习”，他吻功见长，每次一吻起来，就把她吻得晕头转向，连自己姓啥名谁都要记不得了，身子软得几乎要化成一滩水，但体内却的热得宛如沸水在滚，烈火在烹。

若非他自制力强，他们两人说不定早已发乎情，但难以再止乎礼，生米煮成熟饭了。

一吻方毕，见她眉眼含媚、腮颊生晕，路挽风眷恋不舍的放开她，控制着最后一丝理智，快步离开。

两人还未成亲，他不能逾矩轻薄了她，这是对她的尊重。

寒招财粉唇被吻得水润微肿，轻咬着指尖，笑睇着他仓皇离去的背影。

第10章(2)

杏花村。

寒仲文与孔氏夫妻瞠目结舌的看着儿子捎带回来的，那些堆成小山一般的丰厚的礼物，但最让他们惊愕的是，那个摇着肥臀进来，一脸喜气的朝他们喊着“恭喜”的媒人。

孔氏愣愣的问了一句，“不知这喜从何来？”莫非老二看中了哪家的姑娘？

那媒人挥着手绢，张嘴便笑呵呵说着，“喜从路家来！这路家啊不仅仅是皇商，路少东家的大伯父还是朝廷的二品大官工部尚书，论这家世呢，那真是没得垗了，简直是打着灯笼都找不到，如今路少东家瞧上令嫒，聘我为媒，来求娶她为妻，这不是天上掉下来的大喜事吗？”

“路家？”寒仲文有些茫然的看向跟着这媒人一块回来的二儿子，“得福，这究竟是怎么回事？”

好不容易终于有开口的机会，寒得财简单的将事情说了一遍。“……所以路家聘了媒人来提亲，那堆礼物也是路家置办，让我带回来送给爹娘的见面礼。”

在一旁听着的媒人，笑得见牙不见眼的附和道：“哎哟，你瞧瞧，这小俩口郎有情妹有意，可不是天作之合吗，你快把令媛的庚帖拿出来，让我带回去，合了两人的八字之后，路家就可以来下聘了。”

寒仲文脸一沉，抬手重拍桌子，“谁说我要将女儿嫁给路家了？”

那媒人吓了一跳，连难得见到丈夫发怒的孔氏也吃了一惊。

“那路家门第如此之高，咱们家高攀不上！”

媒人一愣之后，连忙表示，“可路家没嫌弃你们呀，还诚心诚意想同你们结亲呐。”

“咱们不结这门亲事。”寒仲文板着脸指着二儿子，“你现在赶回苏云城去，把招财给我带回来。”

见事态急转直下，媒人赶紧说道：“哎哟，这可万万使不得，寒二爷您是不是误会了什么，这路家可是真想求娶令嫒，这般好的亲事，别人求都求不来呢。”

“让他去娶别人家的闺女，我们家不希罕。”

说完，寒仲文便起身走回后院的房里，堂屋里的几人面面相觑。

“娘，我爹这是怎么了？”寒得福一脸纳闷，不知好脾气的爹怎会无端端发起怒来。

“我去瞧瞧你爹。”孔氏略一沉吟，也跟着回了房里。

堂屋里留下媒人和寒得福大眼瞪小眼。

进到房里，看见丈夫坐在床榻边，孔氏走过去坐到他身边。

同丈夫做了二十年的夫妻，丈夫心里怎厶想的，她多少能猜到一些，他这多半是舍不得女儿出嫁，这一嫁还嫁到苏云城，若是想去看她，一趟得走好几天的路程。

“招财都十六岁，也该婚配了。”孔氏好言劝着丈夫。

“她二哥都还没订亲，她急什么？”

“就算再留，也没办法把闺女留太久，她终归要嫁人，如今难得遇到像路家那样好的人家……”

不等妻子说完，寒仲文便道：“路家就是太好了，我才不放心！你想想，咱们招财日后若嫁过去，万一在那儿受了委屈该怎么办？娘家远在杏花村，兄弟们没办法及时过去相帮。”

得知丈夫顾虑的竟是此事，孔氏劝道：“你要是不放心，要不我把儿子叫出来，问问那路家是什么样的人家。”说着，她走到房门朝外头喊了声，将二儿子给叫来来。

“爹、娘。”走进屋里，寒得福不明所以的先瞅了父亲一眼，再看向母亲。

“得福，你方才不是说，你在路家住了两天，你说说这路家的人怎么样？对咱们招财可好？”
content_en:
"With his status as an imperial merchant, can he do whatever he wants?" Although Han Zhaocai was not sure whether the poisoning on the ship was instigated by Lou Zigang, it seemed very likely that it was him. Otherwise, how could there be so many people who hated Lou Zhuxin? Lou Zigang was so cruel and ruthless, and repeatedly paid for the murder of his own sister, yet he was able to escape unscathed and get away with it. How unfair.

Lu Wanfeng promised her, "Don't worry, I won't let him escape the punishment he deserves." She wanted to seek justice for Lou Zhuxin, and he promised to help her, and he would never break his promise.

Han Zhaocai's grievances were instantly soothed by his promise, "Are you doing this for me, or to repay me for saving your life?"

"I once said that your business is my business from now on." He held her hand, his stern face was extremely serious, "Didn't you express your feelings to me before, saying that you would like to be a winged bird in heaven and fly together when disaster strikes. You are willing to fly with me in disaster, and I will not abandon you when something happens to you. No matter what happens in the future, we will bear it together."

"I didn't show any feelings towards you. I just said it casually." She gave him a cute look, then smiled and asked him, "Were you very touched when you heard that, so when you came back, you wanted to marry me?"

"Everything you said is right." Lu Wanfeng didn't want to have a pointless argument with her, so he simply let her go. He finally understood his father's mood.When my mother was talking to her father during her lifetime, some things were clearly unreasonable to her. However, her father, who always kept his word when talking outside, always comforted her with a look of helplessness and said: "Everything the lady said is right, it is all my husband's fault."

That kind of concession is a kind of favor for the mother. It is only natural for a man to give in to his wife.

Lu Wanfeng looked at Han Zhaocai and suddenly thought to himself with some pride.

"What's wrong?" Han Zhaocai was not satisfied with his perfunctory response, "Do you know that a woman's ears need to be fed with some sweetness on a regular basis."

Lu Wanfeng was immediately shocked by his ignorance, "What, such a thing can happen? But why haven't I seen my mother and grandmother do this?"

Seeing that he didn't understand, Han Zhaocai was angry and funny, "It's not good to do this kind of thing in front of outsiders."

"Really?" He looked suspicious.

"If you don't feed sweetness regularly, do you know what will happen?"

He shook his head. It was the first time he heard of such a thing. He didn't know what the consequences would be.Looking at the expression on her face, he vaguely felt that something was wrong. Could it be that she was lying to him?

She told him the answer, "A woman's ears will gradually become hateful without sweet feeding." She stared into his eyes and said slowly word by word, "You don't want me to become like that in the future, do you?"

"Of course not, what should I do?" He finally realized that he seemed to have said something wrong just now, which offended her, and humbly asked her for advice.

Seeing that he was such a teachable child, she smiled and gave advice, "Don't deal with me casually in the future. Be more serious when you say sweet words. This way, my ears will be sweet and I can maintain my beauty like a flower."

Could he go to the side to puke first and then come back to talk to her?He found her current face extremely pleasing to the eye, but she was still far away from being as beautiful as a flower. The face of Lou Zhuxin before was well deserved.

He thought about whether he should tell her the truth, but the next moment he thought it was better to forget it and make her happy.

"In my heart, no matter what you are, you are the most beautiful." He held her in his arms and kissed her sharp mouth.

He doesn't know much sweet words, but he can use practical actions to make her sweet to her heart.

Han Zhaocai was fascinated by his kiss. It must have been that the two of them had been "practicing" a lot recently. He was good at kissing. Every time he kissed her, she would be so dizzy that she couldn't even remember her own name. Her body was so soft that she almost turned into a puddle of water, but her body was as hot as boiling water and a burning fire.

If it weren't for his strong self-control, the two of them might have been in love long ago, but it was difficult to stop being polite and cook the rice.

After the kiss, seeing her charming eyebrows and dizzy cheeks, Lu Wanfeng reluctantly let go of her, controlled the last bit of reason, and left quickly.

The two were not yet married, so he could not overstep the rules and treat her lightly. This was a sign of respect for her.

Han Zhaocai's pink lips were moist and slightly swollen from the kiss. He bit his fingertips lightly and looked at his back with a smile as he left in a hurry.

Chapter 10(2)

Xinghua Village.

Han Zhongwen and Mr. Kong were dumbfounded as they looked at the mountains of rich gifts that their son had brought back. But what shocked them the most was the matchmaker who came in with his fat butt swaying and shouted "Congratulations" to them with a happy face.

Kong asked blankly, "I wonder where this happiness comes from?" Could it be that the second child had his eyes on a girl from a certain family?

The matchmaker waved his handkerchief, opened his mouth and said with a smile, "I'm glad to be from the Lu family! This Lu family is not just an imperial merchant. The uncle of Lu Shaodong's family is also the second-rank official of the imperial court. As for the family background, it is really bad. It's almost impossible to find her with a lantern. Now Lu Shaodong's family has taken a fancy to my daughter-in-law, hired me as a matchmaker, and asked to marry her. Isn't this a great event that fell from the sky?"

"The Lu family?" Han Zhongwen looked at his second son who came back with the matchmaker in confusion, "Defu, what on earth is going on?"

Finally getting a chance to speak, Han Decai simply explained the matter."...So the Lu family hired a matchmaker to propose marriage. The Lu family also bought the pile of gifts and asked me to bring them back as a meeting gift for my parents."

The matchmaker who was listening on the side laughed so hard that he couldn't see his eyes and echoed: "Oh, look, this young couple is interested in a lover. Isn't it a match made in heaven? Quickly take out the daughter's wedding invitation and let me take it back. After matching their horoscopes, the Lu family can come and hire her."

Han Zhongwen's face sank, and he raised his hand and slammed the table, "Who said I was going to marry my daughter to the Lu family?"

The matchmaker was startled, and even Mrs. Kong, who rarely saw her husband angry, was also taken aback.

"That family's family status is so high, our family can't reach it!"

After being stunned for a moment, the matchmaker quickly said, "But the Lu family doesn't dislike you, and they sincerely want to marry you."

"Let's not get married." Han Zhongwen pointed at his second son with a straight face, "You rush back to Suyuncheng now and bring me the fortune."

Seeing that the situation had taken a turn for the worse, the matchmaker quickly said, "Oh, this is absolutely impossible. Mr. Han, have you misunderstood something? This Lu family really wants to marry my daughter-in-law. No one else can ask for such a good match."

"It's not uncommon for our family to let him marry someone else's daughter."

After saying that, Han Zhongwen got up and walked back to the room in the backyard. Several people in the main room looked at each other.

"Mom, what's wrong with my father?" Han Defu looked puzzled, wondering how his good-tempered father could get angry for no reason.

"I'm going to see your father." Mrs. Kong pondered for a moment and then returned to the room.

The matchmaker and Han Defu were left in the hall, staring with big eyes.

When she entered the room, she saw her husband sitting by the bed. Mrs. Kong walked over and sat next to him.

She has been married to her husband for twenty years. She can guess a little bit about what her husband is thinking. He is probably reluctant to let his daughter get married. This time he married her to Su Yuncheng. If he wanted to see her, he would have to walk for several days.

"Zhu Cai is sixteen years old, it's time to get married." Ms. Kong persuaded her husband kindly.

"Her second brother hasn't even gotten engaged yet, why is she anxious?"

"Even if I stay, I can't keep my daughter for too long. She will eventually get married. It's rare to meet a good family like the Lu family nowadays..."

Before his wife could finish speaking, Han Zhongwen said, "The Lu family is so good that I don't worry about it! Think about it, if we get married in the future, what should we do if we get wronged there? My mother's family is far away in Xinghua Village, and the brothers can't go there in time to help."

Knowing that her husband was worried about this matter, Mrs. Kong advised, "If you are worried, why don't I call my son out and ask what kind of family the Lu family is." After saying that, she walked to the door and shouted outside, calling her second son.

"Dad, Mom." Walking into the room, Han Defu glanced at his father without knowing why, and then at his mother.

"Defu, didn't you just say that you stayed at the Lu family for two days, how about the people in the Lu family? Are they good for us to attract wealth?"
